trigger.disclosure: The 12% fit target was motivated by a post-hoc sensitivity diagnosis on previously inspected calibration groups. The resulting thresholds are not reused or promoted. No final prediction has been observed.

method.name: conservative_empirical_policy_with_independent_validation
method.temperature_fit: Existing per-type proper-scoring temperature fitting, minimum temperature 1.0, on group hash bucket 0.
method.policy_fit: Maximize empirical answer coverage under expected error at most 0.12 on separate group hash bucket 1; include all equal-confidence ties.
method.runtime_policy: Existing per-type maximum-probability thresholds; one backbone forward and zero generated answer tokens.

independent_policy_validation.failure: Stop before final inference; preserve the failure and do not refit against these validation labels.
independent_policy_validation.uncertainty_reporting: Report paired observation-group bootstrap intervals descriptively. They are not finite-sample guarantees under distribution shift.

sequence: audit original selected weights, source/data lineage and failed regression
construct and independently audit two disjoint fresh calibration populations
freeze a continuation selection retaining the original development-selected weights
fit temperature and conservative thresholds on fitting data
freeze calibrated weights, manifest and policy before new validation inference
apply unchanged policy to all independent validation groups
apply unchanged policy to exact original policy groups
freeze final evaluation only if every preceding gate passes
original final comparison, regressions, runtime, acceptance and HF preparation/verification
limitations: New familiar-workflow calibration uses authored explicit policies, not newly sampled original teacher annotations. The previous-group regression and original official workflow regression remain mandatory. All numerical release gates stay unchanged. The study targets abstention robustness and does not itself improve raw answer accuracy.
